description: Feet above ground does not fall within the Altitude bin (exactly 1,000 ft is treated as < 1000 ft, following the supplier's practice)
why_it_matters: Altitude analysis can use either field; if they disagree, reports built on each will contradict each other

description: Effect: Indicated Damage is 'Caused damage' but Cost: Total $ is 0
why_it_matters: Total cost of damage is understated; $0 probably means 'not reported' rather than 'no cost'

description: Cost: Total $ is above 0 but Effect: Indicated Damage is 'No damage'
why_it_matters: Contradictory record - either the damage flag or the cost is wrong

description: Wildlife: Number Struck Actual does not fall within the Wildlife: Number struck bin
why_it_matters: Counts of wildlife struck can use either field; they must agree

description: Flight date or airport is missing
why_it_matters: Record cannot appear in trends over time or airport analysis, so totals by date/airport are understated
